events.label: Independent International Scientific Panel on AI preliminary report

slots.name: panel members
slots.sentence: The panel includes 40 members drawn from all five U.N. regions and selected across 140 countries.

slots.name: computing power share
slots.sentence: The report highlighted the concentration of AI development, noting that the U.S. and China account for roughly 75% and 15% of computing power among the world’s largest 500 AI supercomputers, respectively; and agentic systems’ software task capacity is doubling roughly every four to seven months while reliable control methods lag.
